create_ILAgent: create an ILAgent with a model, learning rates, and mini-batch size for imitation learning
run_ILAgent_update: run the ILAgent update method to train on rollouts using cross-entropy action loss
customize_ILAgent_hooks: customize the ILAgent before_backward and before_step hooks for gradient clipping or logging
init_DecentralizedDistributedMixin: initialize distributed training with DecentralizedDistributedMixin to wrap the model in DDP
create_DDPILAgent: create a DDPILAgent that combines ILAgent with distributed data parallel training support
